steps.name: Mischievous Kid
steps.text: Ma, look, a fight!

steps.name: Busy Woman
steps.text: Happens all the time, haggling turning into a fight. Nothing to see.

steps.name: Busy Woman
steps.text: Stay close, I don't know how I'd find you if you got lost here.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: They won't give up so easily. Protecting ourselves is one thing, but it'll be hard to avoid harming civilians.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Do you have an idea?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: There's a way out, but you'll have a mess on your hands...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Wait––

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: (Damn, too late—)

a.text: The Shanhaizhong dart through the crowds like fins through water.
The fins leap from the water en masse. Zuo Le and Lee cannot hope to fend off their attacks without harming the surrounding civilians.
Not scattered flakes of snow, but a steady stream of white.
The blizzard cuts off the rapid flow, stopping the Shanhaizhong in their tracks.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: (Groans)
Such a response is more than just talent and training; it is the result of experience accumulated from countless deadly battles.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Leave.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Don't chase.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: There are too many people here. These villains have no qualms about harming innocents.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (Heavy panting)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Q-Qiubai... it's been a while...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: It's been a while, but you don't seem to have gotten any better.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Why have you come?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: The Grandmaster instructed me to help you.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: And who is this gentleman?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: A friend I met on a previous mission... and an old acquaintance of Liang's.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Someone without an official position shouldn't involve himself in this—even a friend of Liang's.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Ah, well, I just happened to pass by.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Anyway, someone always tells me not to meddle whenever I'm hired to do something. Guess it's a private eye trope.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: My life would have been in danger if not for your help. But are you really here by chance?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Would the Sui Regulator believe me if I said yes?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No jokes, please. This is important.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I never look for trouble; trouble just has a tendency to find me.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'll leave it that my client is an acquaintance of Chief Wei of Lungmen. You may have already met him at the barracks last night.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I guess the ones who attacked you just now were the people he hired me to find.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What else do you know about what happened in Yumen last night?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Not much. The ones who hire private eyes aren't exactly the talkative type. You get used to it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Maybe I could help, if you told me more.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I stabbed the assassin in the scuffle last night, so I started my search in the clinics.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I searched every single clinic in the city and didn't find anything unusual, until the last one. A man called himself a helper and would not let me in.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I forced my way in and found gauze and blood. The man ran off with an agitated look on his face.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Someone has the nerve to obstruct the Sui Regulator in Yumen?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I wasn't sure what to make of it. Obstruction of justice is a crime, but I couldn't make heads or tails of what the man was talking about. It didn't feel premeditated.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Could you describe the man in more detail?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Let me think...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Feline, male. Looks to be in his forties... exceptionally skilled in kung fu.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Could it really be him?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: We should hurry. Yühsia wants us to visit the deceased bodyguard's family.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I'm coming, I'm coming. This is the last house anyway.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Say, I haven't had the chance to ask you... why did you come to Yumen?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I told you, I set up my own logistics company.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Mr. Zheng told me his daughter came to Yumen too, but I didn't expect to actually meet you.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: That's how fate works, I guess.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Say, since we've worked together on this case, wouldn't it be natural for you to join Xingyu Logistics afterwards?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You're still talking about this?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Anyway, it seems like Yühsia dragged a lot of people she knows into this.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I didn't know she was the Rat King's daughter.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: You know Mr. Lin too?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Not really. Dad's heard of him on his travels.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I thought you would know each other well, being fellow Lungmenites.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Lungmen isn't exactly one of those small towns where everybody knows everybody...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I see Mr. Lin from time to time in the course of my work, but I've only heard rumors about Yühsia.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I'm curious... what do Lungmenites think of the Rat King?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: The word 'Lungmenite' is way too broad.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Some think of him as a benevolent protector. Some want as little to do with him as possible. Others just see him as a kindly old man.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Only one thing is certain—he's the key to Lungmen's peace and security.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Sounds like someone not to be trifled with... must be hard being Miss Lin.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Why do you say that?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Fathers always want their children to walk the path they paved for them.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Especially accomplished fathers.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Do you not get along with Mr. Zheng?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I wouldn't say that... it's more like I prefer some distance between us.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Some fathers out there don't care about their children at all.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: They do as they please, leaving their children for somebody else to care for. They disappear for a decade without a word.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Do you mean...?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Never mind, I don't want to bring him up now.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: If the old man went missing for a decade, I would take over the association and rebuild it in my own image.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: I would show him that I can do better.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: But what if he never comes back to see how well you've done?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: This is the place.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hello? Anybody home?

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Excuse me. We're—

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Hey, the door's unlocked. And there's nobody in the clinic.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: This is the fourth place.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: The guard who died was the son of the doctor here. The doctor's a local who's been running the clinic for decades. No other members in the household.

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: News of the Messenger's death reached the city yesterday afternoon. The doctor should already know.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: But the room is neat and tidy. Not a speck of dust on the furniture. The two bags in the corner look like items from today's market.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: I don't know Yumen customs, but it's as though nothing happened whatsoever.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: How would a father react to the news that his child is dead?

steps.name: Du Yaoye
steps.text: Certainly wouldn't act like nothing happened, at least.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: But there's no one home. It's not right for us to barge in.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Let's rendezvous with Yühsia.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: The warehouse that the smuggler talked about is just ahead.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: Strange...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Do you know this place?

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: I checked out the various depots in the city when I visited last time. This warehouse was used by the South Side Sword Forge for storing metals and Originium fuel.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: The Sword Forge is a reputable business operation. It shouldn't have anything to do with this.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: Yau mou gaau coh?! He played us for fools!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Take it easy.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: We're in no rush.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: He doesn't have the nerve to lie in a situation like that. We're already here; all we need to do is take a look.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You keep watch. I'll check it out.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: Be careful.

steps.name: Warehouse Guard
steps.text: Lost your way, miss?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Isn't this the stonemason's warehouse?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm here to buy stone.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Your boss couldn't sculpt his way out of a shoebox, but the stone's not half-bad, so I thought I would buy a bunch.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: He gave me permission to come to the warehouse. He says you'll show me around.

steps.name: Warehouse Guard
steps.text: Zhong's Stonemason?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Think so. The shop at the east end of the market.

steps.name: Warehouse Guard
steps.text: Zhong's Stonemason's warehouse is on the west side. This is the south side.

steps.name: Warehouse Guard
steps.text: So you can stop right there.

steps.name: Warehouse Guard
steps.text: Look around you. Nothing but iron and scrap metal, not a rock to be found.

steps.name: Warehouse Guard
steps.text: I'm sure you're lost.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Damn, I even paid a guide to take me here! That fraud...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Sorry for the intrusion.

steps.name: Warehouse Guard
steps.text: It's fine. Let me see you out.
The clouds part to let the bright sun shine through, stinging Lin Yühsia's skin slightly. She subconsciously reaches behind her neck, then looks up at the man.
What kind of attire would leave a sunburn on the neck like that?

steps.name: Warehouse Guard
steps.text: What are you looking at?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Nothing. Goodbye.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: How did it go?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Stay here and keep a close eye out for nearby movement.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: Something didn't seem right?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Don't ask questions. Just keep your eyes peeled, and report anything unusual.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: Roger.
